q1.question: What is Tekizz?
q1.answer: A quiz platform for tech enthusiasts. Two games: QCM to test your knowledge under pressure, Smatch to match terms and definitions against the clock.

q2.question: Who is it for?
q2.answer: Anyone interested in tech — devs, students, SREs, data scientists, cybersecurity enthusiasts. If you want to test and strengthen your fundamentals, Tekizz is for you.

q3.question: Is it free?
q3.answer: Yes. Just create an account. No limit on the number of games. The global leaderboard and detailed statistics are available to everyone.

q4.question: What question categories are there?
q4.answer: Algorithms, data structures, networking, security, DevOps, OS, databases, tech culture. Content is regularly updated — and you can contribute by submitting your own questions.

q5.question: How does the leaderboard work?
q5.answer: Based on your average score across all your games. Updated in real time after each session. QCM and Smatch leaderboards are independent.
